title: Hi-Five (K-Movie)
synopsis: The five ordinary people, who developed their superpowers after receiving organ transplants from a previously superpowered being, fighting against another psychic, who also gained the power through transplant and covets their powers.

synopsis_lang.en: The five ordinary people, who developed their superpowers after receiving organ transplants from a previously superpowered being, fighting against another psychic, who also gained the power through transplant and covets their powers.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
《Moving超異能族》《屍殺列車》神級團隊最新超乎想像特技動作喜劇，《陽光姊妹淘》賣座導演姜炯哲領軍，打造《炸雞特攻隊》後爆笑英雄聯盟！

 

跆拳道口靚妹、廢嗡宅男、歡樂師奶、社畜大叔、寸嘴型男，5個平凡到不能的陌路人，分別從神秘人身上獲得心、肝、瞳、肺、腎，接受移植後，一夜之間擁有超能力！變身異能人的他們成立互助小組解決生活難題。怎料他們接連發生奪命意外，背後原來還有一位接受胰臟移植的高手謀劃大戰，要用異能操控世界。「集合吧！超異能特攻！」5個平凡人組成臨時特攻隊誓要以奇招對抗邪惡力量。

cast: Yoo Ahin, Ra Miran, Lee Jaein, Ahn Jaehong, Kim Hiewon, Oh Jungse, Park Jinyoung
